universe: KR FDR_KS200 price index; US original YAHOO_GSPC price index. Exact SOURCES.json hashes only.
window: KR first weekly decision on/after 2007-01-01; US on/after 1993-02-01; original complete session grids, original week-end/next-session-close rules. No warm-up date changes.
cohort: Sealed C0 target <1.0 on weekly decision date, including sealed hold-previous-on-missing state. Complete M1/M2 covariates and H63 endpoint/path on common mask; no future trough/rebound/event filter.
negative_control: C0 target exactly 1.0, independently fitted with identical model/training/support rules. Descriptive, cannot rescue primary.
target: H63 PRIMARY: simple price-index return from execution session close e to e+63 minus predeclared ZERO local nominal cash return. H21 same formula, descriptive secondary. No ETF total return splice. No transaction cost subtraction from a forecast target; original regional trading costs documented in SOURCES.json.
features: M0 training mean; M1 FAST categorical dummies 1/2 (0 reference), SLOW binary, TRANSITION binary. M2 M1 + signed close[d]/close[d-63]-1 + sample realized log-return std(last21)/std(last63)-1, ddof=1. Exactly two additions, no sign selection, thresholds, interactions or grids.
missingness: Before label arithmetic/fit: persist EVERY schedule date ID, common eligible slots, cohort and all missing reasons. Pending H63/finality, invalid trailing/forward price, undefined zero vol or missing states excluded identically from M0/M1/M2. No filling or proxy. Invalid state/C0/schedule hard failure.
fit: Expanding one-decision-ahead folds, separately within region/cohort. Training y final strictly before test decision; maturity+63 sessions strictly before decision (H63 embargo). H21 uses SAME conservative H63 mask/train rows. Per fold minimum 12 greedily disjoint H63 training windows; this is a support proxy, not iid episodes. Training-only centering/population std; zero-variance scale 1. Ridge mean squared error + 1.0*sum(beta^2); intercept unpenalized; no hyperparameter search.
primary_score: Mean paired OOS squared-error difference M1 minus M2 in squared decimal-return units. Positive favors M2. M0/M1/M2 use identical actual train/test date IDs.
single_test: ONE intersection-union primary claim: M2 improves BOTH KR AND US. H0 at least one region delta<=0, H1 both delta>0. Joint p=max(pKR,pUS); no independence assumption, no separate country discoveries. Each region must have marginal 95% lower CI>0 AND one-sided p<0.05 AND power/data gates. No mandatory Holm; halves, H21, safety, control never enter another claim.
dependence: Align paired losses to fixed bins floor(exchange-session-position/126); retain all intervening empty bins. Circular moving-block bootstrap resamples TWO adjacent bins (252 sessions) preserving sum(loss)/count with gaps, fixed numpy default_rng seed 31202 and 9999 draws. Center draws about observed delta; basic 2-sided 95% CI=delta-[q975,q025]; one-sided centered p=(1+count(bootstrap centered>=observed delta))/10000. Marginal CIs are not simultaneous. Exploratory asymptotic calibration assumes sufficiently weak dependence; not finite-sample exact, not iid weekly t tests, and occupied bins are not independent crisis episodes.
power: Before any labels/fit require >=32 occupied 126-session potential OOS bins in EACH region after train gate. 32 is ceil(((z.975+z.80)/0.5)^2), planning floor for standardized block effect 0.5, not proof of independent episodes. After single primary calculation require approximate 80% MDE=(1.95996398454+0.84162123357)*bootstrap_sd <=0.0005 squared-return units per region. MDE is asymptotic planning sensitivity, not observed power or an economic threshold. Failure/undefined CI consumes run and stops POWER_BLOCKED; do not lower floors.
safety: Within H63/H21, index minimum return from execution close <= -15% is secondary downside event (not maximum peak-to-trough drawdown). Report event counts and M0/M1/M2 Brier. Fixed ridge linear probability forecasts clipped to [0,1], not calibrated probabilities; DESCRIPTIVE ONLY, cannot establish rare-event skill or rescue recovery-return result.
report: KR/US separately: actual equal-model n, M0/M1/M2 MSE, delta/CI/p, events/Brier; chronological OOS halves descriptive; common IDs/full missingness, fold training counts/support/latest maturity, non-stressed control. Joint verdict GO_TO_ECONOMIC_COMPARISON only if both gates pass. No automatic trading mapping or economic run.
source_availability: Original sealed 4-calendar-day FRED lag/staleness, month-end SLOW and expanding weekly TRANSITION functions imported unchanged. Decision close known by end-of-day; labels matured/final by strictly earlier session, plus 63-session embargo. All source series remain APPROXIMATE_AVAILABILITY_NOT_PIT_EXACT; no vintage certification is invented.
errors_and_first_look: Default command hashes only package; no market data read. Authenticated owner JSON exact-head approval in NEW Draft PR + narrow C.7/stop-list exception + independent non-author exact-head approved audit + exact sources + durable output required. Atomic permanent GitHub study lock created before parsing values; immutable fsynced access, eligibility and result receipts. Any post-lock exception permanently consumes experiment; no ref deletion, source repin, retry, parameter correction or historical replay. No old workflow dispatch.
stop: If insufficient support, stop before label arithmetic or fit with POWER_BLOCKED and absent scores. If delta nonpositive, unsupported CI or MDE, stop NO_EVIDENCE/POWER_BLOCKED. No feature expansion, candidate grids, new roadmap, live allocation, production, promotion or merge. Passive remains default. Historical fit-OOS means time-ordered prediction only, never independent new evidence. No new alpha established without an executed admissible test.
